I'm focusing on the implementation of `Icons.tsx` for Lucide wrappers, complex grid logic for `Calendar.tsx`, input forms for `PlanCreator.tsx`, the side panel and chat for `PlanDetail.tsx`, and overall orchestration in `App.tsx`.
